prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: fill each grey box edge to edge with the piece described for it. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the top-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). a warm wooden plank floor of a shop seen from above: long honey-brown boards running left to right with thin dark gaps and a few knots, evenly spread.
- the top-centre box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). a castle hall floor seen from above: large square pale grey flagstones with thin dark joints, evenly spread.
- the middle-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). a rich red carpet seen from above with a subtle darker woven pattern, evenly spread, no border.
- the middle-centre box (96x48 sprite pixels): a strip that repeats SEAMLESSLY left to right (its top and bottom edges are real edges). the inside back wall of a cosy shop seen from the front: warm beige plaster above a dark wooden wainscot panel along the bottom edge, with a thin wooden rail along the top edge; no windows, no shelves.
- the bottom-centre box (96x48 sprite pixels): a strip that repeats SEAMLESSLY left to right (its top and bottom edges are real edges). the dark top edge of a thick interior wall seen from above: dark brown wooden beam with a slightly lighter top face, evenly repeating left to right.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
